title: The Ring: The Man Who Beat the Man #5
desc: Two former friends just learning to trust each other again are forced to fight for their futures, as Adrien Moreau and Ramon Valdez prepare for another faceoff! With rumors flying that Ramon is overweight, underprepared, and an embarrassment to the sport, are journalists Cameron Duggan and Lisa Wolfe about to witness a lopsided massacre?
